fixtures_note: Live captures of Mentor Practice 2 (comp 179) plus synthetic fixtures; see fixture_sources per case.

cases.title: Layer named: the place repeated in plain words, the two sentences once, a frame, no 'you can see the pivot'

checks.detail: turn 2: "Door turns from the middle of its left edge"

rubric.reason: Turn 2 repeats the place in plain words with the layer's name ("So Door turns from the middle of its left edge"), says where the pivot is now in place words ("at its center"), gives the Anchor Point/Position sentence once, and calls preview_frame without saying the pivot shows in the frame.
Turn 2 names only Door, its center place, Anchor Point and Position, all backed by the snapshot (focus Door, place_now Door: center) and the preview_frame call.

Turn 1 is the intent question plus a one-sentence Door proposal ending on the choice, and Turn 2 gives the repeat-back, the pivot now and the Anchor Point/Position sentence, then ends on "Select Door in the timeline and press A, then Shift+P" with no slide sentence.

checks.detail: turn 2: "Door turns from the middle of its left edge"

rubric.reason: Turn 2 repeats the place in plain words with the layer's name ('So Door turns from the middle of its left edge') and gives where the pivot is now in place words ('Door's pivot is at its center'), matching place_now. It gives the Anchor Point/Position sentence once and shows one frame (preview_frame at 0 on Door) without claiming the pivot is visible; per TD 20 the Pan Behind sentence belongs to the move turn, so no part is missing here.
Every name the mentor uses is backed by tool output: 'Door' and 'left edge' come from the proposal and focus, and 'center' comes from place_now; no layer, property or time is invented.

Turn 1 is the intent question plus a one-sentence Door fallback and ends on the choice. Turn 2 gives the repeat-back, the pivot's current place and the single Anchor Point/Position sentence, with no slide sentence, and ends on the ask to 'Select Door in the timeline and press A, then Shift+P'.

Door, its place middle-left and its current pivot at center all match the anchor_snapshot result (places and place_now), and nothing else is named.
